name: AddItemVersionInput
description: Represents the input for adding an item version.

inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: The name of the item database.

inputFields.name: itemId
inputFields.description: The item ID. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: version
inputFields.description: The item version to use as the base for creating a new version. Default is latest version.

inputFields.name: versionName
inputFields.description: The name of the item version.
